proposed_capability: Bind quality-enrolled fertilizer purchase observations to the active household, lot and build. Preserve current verified owned transfers and exact personal inventory use when independent optional scan evidence is stale.
player_save_control_impact: Pure current-observation proposals, preserving human, needs, queue and save authority. No native input, save or Windows settings changes.
expected_outcome: Contradictory or absent sourcing scope cannot propose a purchase. Independently verified, admitted lot stock and available pocket stock remain usable when an unrelated older optional survey cannot prove absence. Pending acquisition prevents replay.
negative_tests: Cross-household, cross-lot, cross-build and missing source scope
Stale optional backyard evidence cannot authorize purchase or block an otherwise verified owned transfer
rollback_path: Revert gardening closeout PR; no save or game effect
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build EA affordances, purchase settlement, native activation and outcome proof belong to issue #171.
decision_rationale: P83 reproduced reachable advisory bugs against current main. Preserve native activation as a separate exact-build gate and preserve legacy observation behavior.
